curve.model: binary Weierstrass y^2 + x*y = x^3 + a*x^2 + b

endomorphism.proof_status: Sage replay verifies pi(G)=lambda*G; lambda has exact order 71 modulo prime r, so the signed Frobenius orbit has size 142; ordinary-volcano data and conductors do not apply or remain unknown.

factor_base.construction: Scan polynomial-basis x words from raw_x=1 upward. Lift each x to curve points, multiply by the cofactor to project into the prime-order subgroup, reject identity and projected x<=1, retain the first representative for each minimum x over its Frobenius orbit, and append its complete signed Frobenius orbit.
factor_base.point_encoding: ordered affine points as unsigned polynomial-basis integer coordinates; canonical digest covers ordered coordinates and orbit labels
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient_rule: Fold complete +/- Frobenius orbits; representative labels are +/- lambda^i mod r.
factor_base.subgroup_filter: Multiply by the curve cofactor; identity is excluded; the resulting points lie in the prime-order subgroup.

field.element_encoding: unsigned polynomial-basis integer with coefficient bit i; decimal strings on JSON interfaces
field.representation: polynomial basis over F2; coefficient of x^i is bit i

point_decomposition.cache_policy: Construct factor base, normal basis, S3 root index, and factor-base logarithms in process; no cross-run persistent cache.
point_decomposition.monomial_order: not_applicable (closed-form S3 half-trace solver and root index)
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial_chain: Build a root index from representative-pair S3 x-coordinate roots and relative Frobenius shifts. For a target, search S3 roots against target x, canonicalize the partner under Frobenius, join through the pair-root index, lift four x coordinates through factor-base buckets, and verify the exact four-point group sum.
point_decomposition.weil_descent_encoding: S3 x-coordinate roots over the polynomial-basis field; a derived normal basis represents Frobenius as cyclic rotation.

relation_collection.duplicate_dependency_handling: Insert verified relation rows into incremental modular echelon form; count dependent rows without treating them as rank gain.
relation_collection.filtering: S3 root candidate, canonical root-index lookup, factor-base x-bucket lift, and exact group-sum verification.
relation_collection.stop_criterion: Recover all 600 factor-base orbit logarithms, then solve exactly one supplied target.
relation_collection.target_distribution: One supplied public target point Q; the candidate requires the point input and does not require its discrete logarithm.
relation_collection.verification: Exact group equation for each admitted relation and an in-process [d]G=Q check for the recovered target.
relation_collection.walk_or_sampling_rule: For target-independent log acquisition, generate known scalars from the deterministic LCG stream and pivot-guide the decomposition of [a]G-R_j for the first pivotless orbit column. For the online target, derive the root-index starting offset only from Q coordinates.

relation_linear_algebra.matrix_construction: 600 signed-Frobenius orbit unknowns plus a right-hand side; relation coefficients are accumulated from the four signed-orbit labels.
relation_linear_algebra.orbit_quotient: signed Frobenius; one column per representative

target_descent.policy: direct: sum the four signed-Frobenius label coefficients times the recovered representative logarithms modulo r
target_descent.success_rule: exact four-point relation, recovered scalar, and independent [d]G=Q replay
